default_hosts.description: The unnamed default table. Rows of pattern (a PCRE matching the requested hostname) and target (an IP address with optional port, or unix:/path). Targets must be addresses: this sniproxy has no DNS resolver.

http_fallback.description: Backend used when the HTTP request cannot be parsed — an address, not a hostname (the shipped localhost:8080 makes this build refuse the file).

http_hosts.description: The http_hosts table (HTTP listener). Rows of pattern (a PCRE matching the requested hostname) and target (an IP address with optional port, or unix:/path). Targets must be addresses: this sniproxy has no DNS resolver.

http_listen.description: Port (or address:port) the HTTP listener binds.

https_hosts.description: The https_hosts table (TLS listener). Rows of pattern (a PCRE matching the requested hostname) and target (an IP address with optional port, or unix:/path). Targets must be addresses: this sniproxy has no DNS resolver.

https_listen.description: Port (or address:port) the TLS listener binds.

log_priority.description: Verbosity of the error log (syslog priority).

user.description: User the daemon drops privileges to.
